## 1. Owner creation logic

Owner entities are created and persisted in the V1 REST controller, not in a dedicated `OwnerService`.

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`
- `addOwner(...)` is the create endpoint. It maps the DTO to an `Owner`, runs a chain of validators/normalizers, then persists and audits:
```
188  public ResponseEntity<OwnerDto> addOwner(OwnerFieldsDto ownerFieldsDto, String idempotencyKey) {
...
194      Owner owner = ownerMapper.toOwner(ownerFieldsDto);
...
213      this.clinicService.saveOwner(owner);
214      ownerAuditLogger.logCreated(owner);
215      ownerIdempotencyStore.record(idempotencyKey, owner.getId());
```
- Injected audit logger field/ctor at lines 108 and 129.

Persistence itself is in `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/service/ClinicServiceImpl.java` (`saveOwner` → `ownerRepository.save(owner)` at lines 159 and 264).

`OwnerRestControllerV2` (`/home/daniel/sandbox/.../rest/controller/v2/OwnerRestControllerV2.java`) only implements `listOwnersPage` — it has no create logic.

## 2. Where the audit line is emitted (and the "AUDIT" logger)

The audit call site is `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner` line 214: `ownerAuditLogger.logCreated(owner);`

The audit line itself is emitted by `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/OwnerAuditLogger.java`, a `@Component` that owns the dedicated `AUDIT` SLF4J logger:
```
36  private static final Logger AUDIT = LoggerFactory.getLogger("AUDIT");
...
49  public void logCreated(Owner owner) {
50      AUDIT.info("Owner created: id={} customerCode={} registrationDate={} membershipLevel={} membershipNumber={}",
51          owner.getId(), owner.getCustomerCode(), owner.getRegistrationDate(),
52          membershipLevelEvaluator.levelFor(owner), MembershipNumber.forOwner(owner));
53  }
```
This is the only production use of a logger literally named `"AUDIT"`. Note it currently emits a human-readable line only — there is NO `OWNER_CREATED` structured event (see items 4 and 5).

## 3. Owner entity/model fields

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java` (extends `Person` → `BaseEntity`):
- `customerCode` — field line 68-69 (`@Column(name = "customer_code") private String customerCode;`), getter/setter lines 166-172.
- `registrationDate` (72), `birthDate` (75), `householdId` (78), `namesakeCount` (81), `possibleDuplicate` (84), `possibleDuplicateOf` (87), `deleted` (90), plus address/contact fields.
- There is NO `membershipLevel`, `memberId`, or `ownerId` field on `Owner`. `membershipLevel` is derived at runtime (item below), and `memberId` does not yet exist anywhere in the codebase.

`id` lives on the base class `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/BaseEntity.java`:
```
33  @Id
34  @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
35  protected Integer id;   // getId()/setId() lines 37-43, isNew() 45
```

Related derived values:
- `membershipLevel` is computed by `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/service/MembershipLevelEvaluator.java` — `levelFor(Owner)` (line 104) and `pointsFor(Owner)` (line 79).
- `membershipNumber` formatted by `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/MembershipNumber.java` — `forOwner(Owner)` (line 33), format `"<customerCode>-M<YY>"`.
- `customerCode` generated by `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/service/CustomerCodeGenerator.java` — `generate(region, normalizedTelephone, lastName)` (line 44), format `"<REGION>-<HASH8>"`.

## 4. Existing structured / JSON event emission

There is no structured/JSON event emission for owner creation. The current audit is a plain formatted log line (item 2). The only JSON-writing code in the codebase is unrelated to auditing:

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/BindingErrorsResponse.java`
```
81  public String toJSON() {
82      ObjectMapper mapper = JsonMapper.builder()...
87      errorsAsJSON = mapper.writeValueAsString(bindingErrors);
```
No `ownerId`/`seq`/`OWNER_CREATED` event, and no `memberId`, exists in `src/main` yet.

## 5. Relevant test files for owner creation and auditing

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AuditLogCapture.java`
- An `AutoCloseable` that attaches a Logback `ListAppender` to the `"AUDIT"` logger (defaults to `"AUDIT"`, line 32) so audit output can be asserted. Helpers: `messages()` (41), `anyContains(String...)` (45), `anyAtLevel(...)` (57), `count()` (71).

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java`
- Test `coreEventCarriesIdAndIdentifier()` (line 14) expects a structured AUDIT event that does not yet exist. The class comment (lines 7-10) specifies the target shape `{seq, ownerId, customerCode, membershipLevel, event:'OWNER_CREATED'}`, and the assertion requires an AUDIT line containing all of `"OWNER_CREATED"`, the owner id, and the `customerCode`:
```
19  assertTrue(audit.anyContains("OWNER_CREATED", String.valueOf(id),
20          r.get("customerCode").asText()));
```
This test will currently fail, since `OwnerAuditLogger` emits only the `"Owner created: ..."` line and no `OWNER_CREATED` marker.

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceBase.java`
- Test harness with helpers `createOwnerOk(JsonNode)` (line 160), `fetchOwner(int)` (200), `knownOwner(String city)` (260), `ownerNode()`, and a `seq()` sequence generator (61).

One note relevant to the apparent intent: the `AcceptanceTest` comment says later checkpoints will "prove the event switched to the memberId," but no `memberId` field/identifier currently exists on `Owner` or anywhere in `src/main` — the present primary identifier is `customerCode`.
